correctness.rationale: A shared support position costs one from distance eight, or two if symbols agree. Thus support pairs meet at most once and each point has each nonzero symbol at most once. Equality at 13 words saturates 52 symbol slots; the 13 column degrees of four account for all 78 row pairs. For the incidence matrix, BB^T=3I+J and both row and column sums are four, giving B^TB=3I+J. This is the unique projective plane of order three, and proper four-edge-colorings give the converse. The color permutation acts freely; coordinate permutations fixing the plane are precisely its point collineations, not dualities. The labeling multiplier is 13!/5616; word order is never counted. A new finite reproduction /tmp/opencode/pg3_review.py enumerated perfect matchings with each of the four fixed-line edges (963 each), paired the matchings with fixed-line slots 0 and 1, and exhausted the alternating phases on the residual cycles subject to the fixed-line normalization. This gave 80640 colorings. It constructed all 5616 projective transformations independently by invertible ternary matrices modulo scalars, used their full actions, and verified that the twenty frozen representatives have disjoint orbits exhausting the independently enumerated domain with sizes 144 once, 1872 seven times, 5616 twelve times. This confirms 1935360 labeled colorings and 2145927168000 labeled codes. The independent check did not execute any source code or depend on the source compiler pipeline.
